globalBriefing: Oil prices above $108/bbl driven by Hormuz traffic collapse to single digits and Middle East conflict escalation (Houthis control Red Sea, Israel deploys 1,100 tonnes of explosives in Lebanon); RBC warns $120 tail risk. US inflation data Friday will determine Fed rate-hike odds; rising Treasury yields pressured S&P 500 yesterday. India equities log fifth consecutive weekly loss as oil fears grip markets and RBI intervenes on rupee defense; IMF credits India resilience but macro headwinds persist across EM. UAE commits €40bn to Germany signaling Gulf capital appetite for European assets; Hong Kong IPO boom draws talent back. FDI deceleration (Philippines -17.8% H1) and Indian legal dispute delays undermine capital confidence. US-Canada tariff escalation and Mexico-US trade deal sprint add trade-policy tail risk pre-election. USDA crop report and US inflation data Friday loom as primary 48-hour catalysts.
marketOpen: Watch USDA crop report and US CPI print Friday; if inflation prints hot, Fed rate-hike pricing accelerates and cross-asset repricing ensues; if soft, oil supply constraints dominate and stagflation concern holds.

macro.label: Macro & Central Banks

items.headline: Fed rate-hike probability rising as traders eye US inflation data amid Treasury yield surge
items.summary: Reuters reports traders are pricing in Fed rate lift odds on US inflation data focus. S&P 500 fell as Treasury yields rose. No specific rate or inflation print cited in today's headlines, but market positioning signals hawkish re-pricing.
items.relevance: Direct impact on US fixed income, equity valuation, and global funding costs; constrains emerging market carry.

items.headline: Bank of Korea weighs another rate hike as inflation pressures build
items.summary: Per UPI, Bank of Korea is considering additional rate increase amid mounting inflationary headwinds. No decision date or prior hike magnitude provided in headline.
items.relevance: Signals regional monetary tightening cycle; ripple effect on Asian FX and credit spreads; compounds emerging market capital outflow risk.

items.headline: IMF maintains 3% global growth forecast for 2026 but warns energy shock risks remain elevated
items.summary: IMF holds growth projection at 3% for 2026 while flagging persistent energy-sector downside risks. India cited by IMF as showing 'quite a lot of resilience' to oil price shock and improved statistical framework.
items.relevance: Confirms baseline growth assumption but acknowledges tail risk from energy volatility; supports defensive positioning in commodity-sensitive emerging markets.

items.headline: Gold gains on softer oil prices; US inflation data in focus
items.summary: Reuters notes gold strength tied to near-term oil pullback, with US inflation print flagged as key determinant of further moves. No gold price level or oil differential cited.
items.relevance: Signals safe-haven demand and inflation hedge appetite; directional signal depends on inflation print outcome.

items.headline: Indian central bank likely intervenes to defend rupee as oil prices climb above $100
items.summary: Reuters reports traders expect RBI intervention to support rupee in response to rising crude. Oil sustained above $100. No intervention size or rupee level specified.
items.relevance: EM FX stability risk; RBI reserves depletion potential if sustained oil elevation; impacts Indian asset valuations and corporate debt service.

items.headline: US federal agencies reduce regulatory burden for community banks, increase 18-month exam cycle eligibility
items.summary: Federal Reserve announces easing of compliance requirements and extended exam cycles for eligible community banks. Policy clarity on size/capital thresholds not provided in headline.
items.relevance: Minor regulatory relief for small-cap US bank valuations; marginal positive for US mortgage/real-estate lending capacity, but limited cross-border or European impact.

macro.keyTakeaway: If US inflation data prints hot Friday, Fed rate-hike pricing accelerates and global funding costs rise further; if soft, oil supply constraints may dominate and maintain stagflation risk for EM.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitics & Security
geopolitics.description: Conflicts, alliances, sanctions, and power shifts

items.headline: Houthis take control of Yemen's Red Sea coast; Iran-backed force threatens key shipping alternative to Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports Iran-backed Houthis have secured control of Yemen's Red Sea coastline, establishing de facto blockade threat to a major alternative shipping corridor. No specific vessel counts or trade volumes affected cited.
items.relevance: Dual chokepoint risk (Hormuz + Red Sea) raises energy logistics cost and insurance premium; drives LNG route diversification and long-duration energy contract repricing.

items.headline: Israeli forces demolish alleged Hezbollah tunnels in south Lebanon with 1,100 tonnes of explosives
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports Israeli military deployed over 1,100 tonnes of explosives to destroy suspected Hezbollah infrastructure in south Lebanon. Intensity and scope of operation underscores military escalation.
items.relevance: Regional conflict intensity elevated; refugee/humanitarian cost; Beirut port and regional trade finance disruption risk; Lebanon credit spreads widen.

items.headline: US naval base in Bahrain sustained heavy damage in war with Iran; US official admits extent of Iranian strikes
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports US official confirmed 'heavy damage' to naval facility near Manama (Bahrain) during Iran-US hostilities. Scale of damage and operational impact not quantified.
items.relevance: Demonstrates Iran military capability in Gulf; raises security cost for US naval presence and petrochemical infrastructure; feeds energy supply-risk premium in crude.

items.headline: Anthropic reveals AI threat intelligence: company blocks possible attempt to use generative AI for biological weapons design
items.summary: BBC reports Anthropic issued threat intelligence disclosing attempted misuse of AI for biological weapons research. Details of approach and detection method not disclosed; comes after former Anthropic researcher warned of AI humanity risks.
items.relevance: Regulatory and liability tail risk for AI/tech sector; potential impetus for AI model release restrictions and compliance cost; marginal negative for venture/PE AI valuations long-term.

geopolitics.keyTakeaway: If Middle East conflict persists and Houthis/Iran maintain Red Sea/Hormuz blockade intensity, dual-chokepoint energy shock becomes structural; LNG contracts and alternative shipping lanes command premium.
